en.p: Find the sum of all natural numbers $n$ for which there exists a quadratic function $f(x)$ with leading coefficient 1 satisfying the following conditions. [4 points]

box: (A) The equation in $x$ $(x^n-64)f(x)=0$ has two distinct real roots, and each real root is a multiple root.
(B) The minimum value of the function $f(x)$ is a negative integer.
